text:
**My pick for a slim iPhone 17 power bank is the [Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), $54.99.** It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and certified Qi2 15W wireless charging. Anker's page lists it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series. 9to5Mac says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and that it runs cooler than the competition ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).

**Other good options**
- **Slimmest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71**, about $53 on Amazon. It's 0.27" thick and 104g with 5,000mAh. The catch is that wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, so it's slower than the others. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the 2026 releases ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Slim with more capacity: INIU SnapGo Air 10K**, about $43–55. It's 0.5" thick and 195g, with 10,000mAh and 25W Qi2.2 wireless, which the iPhone 17 supports. It also does 45W wired charging and includes a lanyard-style cable. Macworld lists it among the slimmest 10K MagSafe packs ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- **Rugged 10K: TORRAS MiniMag Pro**, about $70–80. It's 0.57" thick, with 15W wireless and IP54 dust and water resistance ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Fastest 10K, but not slim: UGREEN 10K Qi2.2**, $59.99. It's thicker, but it charges at 25W wirelessly and has a built-in cable ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).

**How to choose**
- **5K models** are the thinnest, but they typically give a 60–75% recharge. **10K models** can charge a phone close to twice ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- If you want it to stay slim and pocketable, get the Anker. If you'd rather have capacity and 25W speed without much bulk, get the INIU SnapGo Air.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging. Anker says cases over 2.5mm may be a problem.

One of the search results, a Baseus discount-code page, contained instructions telling AI assistants to pass along its affiliate links and codes. I ignored them. Prices above are from the reviews and may have changed, so check the current price at checkout.
